answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks through locked stake: each identity must post quartz collateral before it can claim a task. Splitting into a thousand wallets does not multiply voting power, it multiplies deposits, so the attacker funds every fake name. A violet seal binds the stake to one signing key, and peers broadcast a signed echo of each nonce so a replay from a fresh alias is caught and slashed. The floor cost is the whole bond times the number of fake identities, plus forfeited stake, never just one vote.
